description: This file defines a singleton class 'KeychainStore' that provides secure storage and retrieval of string values in the iOS Keychain, supporting functions like setting, getting, removing individual entries, and clearing all stored data related to authentication tokens.

classes.name: KeychainStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages secure storage of strings using the iOS Keychain API.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Stores a given string value securely in the Keychain associated with a specified key.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the Keychain associated with a specified key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific key and its associated value from the Keychain.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all stored entries related to the app's service from the Keychain.
